subject: planner: remove internal pkg and move base code to certain place (#52620)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: changes are structural moves/renames in planner only (remove Go `internal` packages, relocate base plan implementation to `pkg/planner/core/operator/base`, move test helpers to `pkg/planner/util/coretestsdk`, and move `WrapCastForAggFuncs` to `pkg/planner/util/coreusage`). Production behavior changes are limited to import path updates; the only moved runtime helper (`WrapCastForAggFuncs`) retains identical logic and call sites continue to invoke it. No plausible Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, data consistency, session/txn behavior, privilege/visibility, or concurrency. Later history shows follow-up refactors (e.g., package naming) but no evidence of a correctness fix required for this commit.
